tasks.reading: Motivation is the driving force that helps people work toward their goals. Psychologists often explain that motivation can be either intrinsic or extrinsic. Intrinsic motivation comes from personal interest or enjoyment, while extrinsic motivation involves rewards such as grades or money. Many studies show that students who are intrinsically motivated tend to perform better academically because they enjoy the learning process. Teachers often try to encourage this by creating enjoyable activities, giving students choices, and reducing unnecessary pressure in the classroom.

tasks.reading: Renewable energy comes from natural sources that can be replaced faster than they are used. One common example is solar energy, which comes from the sun. Many countries are investing in solar farms to reduce their dependence on oil and coal. Experts believe that renewable energy will play a major role in fighting climate change.
